name: piper-workspace
description: Piper: merge-train and solo CI-triage state machines.

scripts.prepare: effect-tsgo patch && if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install; fi && mkdir -p .pi/extensions && ln -sfn ../../tools/pi/git-interceptor .pi/extensions/git-interceptor
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/worker/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/executor/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/executor/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shadow/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shadow/test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/observe/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/observe/test/tsconfig.json
